rules.description: Require explicit billing basis and rate ranges; validate the exact synthetic input contract, bounded true integers, unique technical IDs, approved controls, and closed fixed-offset period.

provenance.note: Only the need to state fee basis and ranges is source-backed. The vendor example uses 252 business days. All JSON validation, approval controls, bounds, and calendar choices are sample policies.

rules.description: Exclude pending schedules and approvals after as_of from authority; preserve them as visible evidence without overriding an eligible approved schedule.

provenance.note: The source says pending configuration requests are not effective. The exact synthetic timestamps, flags, and approval fields are sample policies, not authorization.

rules.description: Join half-open engagement, eligible schedule, and explicit constant value intervals. Gaps hold the entire account. Any overlap of eligible approved schedules or authoritative values rejects the whole case.

provenance.note: Fictional evidence-completeness and contradiction rules; no newest-version selection, interpolation, or forward-fill.

rules.description: Allocate value into consecutive marginal bands starting at zero, with strictly increasing finite upper bounds and one final unbounded band; preserve zero-valued slices.

provenance.note: Fictional marginal formula, not householding, a whole-balance cliff, or an IBKR implementation.

rules.description: Include start days and exclude end days. Split on eligible evidence and engagement boundaries and January 1 for actual-calendar-year; alternatively use explicit act-365-fixed.

provenance.note: Invented actual-calendar-day policy with 365/366 denominators; no inferred DST, holidays, market prices, or cash flows.

rules.description: Use exact rational minor units for all segment fees. Sum all segment fractions before one account-period rounding, with explicit half-up or half-even and no numeric coercion.

provenance.note: Invented agreement rounding policy. No intermediate cent rounding or floating approximation.

rules.description: Join exact account/period/currency business keys. One draft permits signed draft-minus-computed comparison using inclusive tolerance. Missing and duplicate drafts are not zero or arbitrary winners.

provenance.note: Fictional comparison and exception precedence. Source schedule labels are context only.

rules.description: Preserve dispositions for every source row, all account/segment/tier/draft details, excluded changes, and separate comparable, missing-draft, duplicate-draft, uncomputed, and not-billable populations. End with pending human review and no live action.

provenance.note: Review-only sample closure. The source offers limited context for presenting method, amount, and period; it does not authorize any action here.

steps.title: Load synthetic billing exports
steps.procedure: Read immutable engagement, schedule, value, and draft arrays; record actual counts and supplied period/as_of.

steps.title: Validate contract and authoritative evidence
steps.procedure: Validate all fields, scalar types, source limits, keys, tier endpoints, fixed-offset closure, approvals, references, and full authoritative intervals before producing trusted fees.

steps.title: Join effective billing segments
steps.procedure: Intersect active dates with eligible schedules and explicit values, split year boundaries when needed, preserve gaps and excluded changes, and show actual evidence IDs and day counts.

steps.title: Calculate marginal value slices
steps.procedure: For coverage-complete accounts, allocate each segment value into every marginal band and record value-times-bps integer numerators, including zero slices.

steps.title: Prorate exactly and round once
steps.procedure: Multiply annual numerators by days, divide exactly by 10000 times the day-count denominator, sum exact fractions, and show each account's sole rounding decision.

steps.title: Compare exact draft business keys
steps.procedure: Classify every draft, distinguish absence from zero and duplicate business keys from technical ID violations, then compare only a unique exact-key draft for a computed account.

steps.title: Route unresolved billing evidence
steps.procedure: Sort the actual gap, pending/future approval, draft exclusion, duplicate, missing, and out-of-tolerance exceptions; attach their codes to affected account reviews.

steps.title: Emit the review-only packet
steps.procedure: Return the complete exact envelope, row dispositions, financial details, and disjoint comparison populations with human_review=pending and live_action=none.
